chunks: And concerning that, there is another hadith with a broken chain, narrated by ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām, who said: Someone who heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام told me, saying:

Indeed, I am amazed at one who desires to perform wudu (ablution) two by two, while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed it two by two. For the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله used to renew the wudu (ablution) for every obligatory prayer and for every prayer.

key_terms.بِإِسْنَادٍ مُنْقَطِعٍ: with a disconnected chain of transmission

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about renewing wudu (ablution) for each prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports, through a disconnected sanad, a statement of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام regarding the practice of wudu (ablution) and the precedent of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. It highlights the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) of renewing wudu (ablution) for each obligatory prayer and each prayer, making it relevant to discussions of ritual purity and prayer practice.
